name: com.vrc-rufu.quest-avatar-converter
description: Generates a Quest/Android-compatible derivative of a PC-platform VRChat avatar without modifying the PC avatar or any asset it references. Converts each referenced Material to a selected VRChat/Mobile shader, merges and resizes each Material's Textures (per classified type: Color/Normal/Mask/Emission), adds AAO's Trace And Optimize component, and reports performance metrics plus individually-flagged Quest-compatibility issues (including PhysBone-specific thresholds) before you upload.
